title: Largest Histogram Rectangle
summary: Return the maximum rectangular area under adjacent histogram bars.
statement: Return the maximum rectangular area under adjacent histogram bars. Implement `largest_histogram_rectangle` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: A lower bar closes every taller rectangle that cannot extend farther.
Store each height with its earliest valid start and finalize it when a smaller height appears.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the largest_histogram_rectangle invariant is complete.
Editorial: Store each height with its earliest valid start and finalize it when a smaller height appears. The intended bounds are O(n) time and O(n) space.
